notes: Mobile Harness Code — v1.8.0: new Web App project type. Import a ready HTML/CSS/JS app (or an already-built React/Vue dist/build folder) as a ZIP, and the Appbuilder wraps it in a secure Android WebView shell (WebViewAssetLoader local origin, no file:// access, strictly scoped JS bridge, external URLs open outside) to produce an installable, signed APK. Existing Compose, XML, Android SDK, PRoot, Gradle and release/signing flows are unchanged. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
